name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 2, 2019
  7:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
This time is for members of the public to address the City Council on Staff Report Item
Nos. 1 and 2. Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card
and give that card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Please observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

STAFF REPORTS

  1. CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF CONSTRUCTION CHANGE ORDER
  FOR THE NORWALK BOULEVARD STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT IN
  THE AMOUNT OF $149,636.11
  STAFF REPORT ATTACHMENT

  2. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS TO CALL A SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  AND OTHER RELATED ACTIONS TO PLACE ON THE MARCH 3, 2020 BALLOT
  A 3/4% GENERAL TRANSACTIONS AND USE (SALES) TAX MEASURE AND A
  MEASURE INCREASING THE TRANSIENT OCCUPANCY (HOTEL) TAX RATE
  FROM 12.5% TO 15%
  STAFF REPORT ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT
  ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or other
issues of concern to City Council members that may briefly be presented at this time.

ADJOURNMENT
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.
minutes_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 2, 2019
  7:00P.M.
The Special Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 7:00p.m., on Monday,
December 2, 2019 in the Artesia City Council Chambers by Mayor Lima.

PRESENT:  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Rene Trevino, Councilmember
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Mayor Pro Tem
  Tony Lima, Mayor

ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  HongDao Nguyen, Assistant City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistance City Clerk

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APPROVE THE AGENDA.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR LIMA.

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS

  City Clerk presented the announcement and reported that there were no Public
  Comments.

STAFF REPORTS

  1. CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF CONSTRUCTION CHANGE ORDER FOR
  THE NORWALK BOULEVARD STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT IN THE AMOUNT
  OF $149,636.11

  City Manager provided staff report.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APPROVAL Item No. 1.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER TREVINO.
   Said motion carried (5-0-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Trevino, Taj, Canales and Lima
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Item No. 1 was approved without objections 5-0-0-0.

2. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS TO CALL A SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION AND
  OTHER RELATED ACTIONS TO PLACE ON THE MARCH 3, 2020 BALLOT A 3/4%
  GENERAL TRANSACTIONS AND USE (SALES) TAX MEASURE AND A MEASURE
  INCREASING THE TRANSIENT OCCUPANCY (HOTEL) TAX RATE FROM 12.5% TO
  15%

  Margaret Saito, resident, provided public comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments and asked questions regarding item.

  City Attorney answered questions regarding item.

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided additional comments and asked additional questions
  regarding item.

  City Attorney and City Manager answered questions regarding item.

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided additional comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.
  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO ADOPT TRANSACTIONS AND USE (SALES)
  TAX RESOLUTIONS NO. 19-2780, 19-2781 and 19-2782.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER TREVINO.
  Said motion carried (4-0-1-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Trevino, Taj and Lima
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Canales
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
   CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Transactions and Use (Sales) Tax Resolutions Failed: (4-0-1-
  0).
  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO ADOPT TRANSIENT OCCUPANCY (HOTEL)
  TAX RESOLUTIONS NO. 19-2783, 19-2784 and 19-2785.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER TREVINO.
  Said motion carried (5-0-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Trevino, Taj, Canales and Lima
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Transactions and Use (Sales) Tax Resolutions passed (5-0-
  0-0).

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Lima adjourned the Special Meeting at 7:41pm
